plugins.name: ag2-workflow-patterns
plugins.description: Multi-agent orchestration patterns for AG2: group chat, sequential, round-robin, and custom workflows

skills.name: ag2-chat-fundamentals
skills.description: Core AG2 conventions that apply to all agent patterns -- LLMConfig, ending chats, agent types, and common APIs. Loaded automatically when building any AG2 workflow.
skills.description_zh: 提供所有 AG2 智能体流程共用的基本约定，包括 LLMConfig、结束对话、智能体类型与常用 API。

skills.name: group-chat-auto-pattern
skills.description: Create a multi-agent group chat using AutoPattern (no handoffs). The Group Chat Manager selects agents automatically based on their descriptions. Use when conversation flow is unpredictable or defining explicit routing rules would be overly complex.
headings: Each agent MUST have a description -- used by Group Chat Manager for routing
AutoPattern -- no handoffs, LLM picks next agent based on descriptions
skills.description_zh: 使用 AutoPattern 创建不设显式交接的多智能体群聊，由管理器按描述自动选择角色，适用于对话路径难预测或路由规则过于复杂的场景。

skills.name: group-chat
skills.description: Create a multi-agent group chat using DefaultPattern with explicit handoffs. Use when you need deterministic control over agent transitions, pipelines with validation gates, hierarchical delegation, or context-aware routing between specialists.
headings: Shared context for tracking state across agents
Tool function that controls handoff via ReplyResult
result.context_variables has the final shared state
result.last_speaker has the last agent's name
Three Ways Agents Access Context Variables
skills.description_zh: 使用 DefaultPattern 和显式交接创建 AG2 群聊，支持确定的角色转换、验证关卡、层级委派和按上下文路由专长角色。

skills.name: nested-chat
skills.description: Create a nested chat workflow where a multi-step pipeline is encapsulated inside a single agent. Use when you want to package a sequence of agent interactions (research, draft, edit) into one agent that runs the pipeline automatically when triggered.
headings: The outer agent that encapsulates the pipeline
Register the nested pipeline -- fires when coordinator receives from user
skills.description_zh: 把研究、起草、编辑等多步骤智能体交互封装为单一智能体中的嵌套聊天流程，在触发时自动运行整条管道。

skills.name: sequential-chat
skills.description: Create a sequential chat workflow where an initiator agent runs through a queue of chats in order. Use for step-by-step pipelines like outline -> plan -> format, where each stage builds on the previous output.
headings: The initiator agent runs the sequential pipeline
skills.description_zh: 创建由发起智能体依次执行聊天队列的 AG2 顺序流程，适用于提纲、计划、格式化等每阶段依赖前一输出的任务。

skills.name: two-agent-chat
skills.description: Create a simple two-agent chat where two agents converse back and forth. The simplest multi-agent pattern -- use for iterative refinement, Q&A, debate, or any task where two roles alternate.
skills.description_zh: 创建两个智能体轮流对话的基本 AG2 模式，适用于迭代改进、问答、辩论和双角色交替工作。
